I could not determine these answers. The declarations only give signatures. `attachFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene?)` returns `() => void` and takes no options, so they say nothing about which mouse or touch inputs turn the camera. I've written the file with `null` for each value rather than guessing `true` or `false`.

FILE: app/notes/pointer-lock.json
```json
{ "lockedNoButton": null, "lockedButtonHeld": null, "rightDrag": null, "touchDrag": null }
```

I worked only from the pasted declarations, not from the library source or a running app, and I did not check the file on disk. To get real answers, read the implementation behind `attachFreeControl` (the free-camera controls source in the library build) or test the four cases in a browser with the render loop running. Those tests would also show whether `movementX`/`movementY` are used while the pointer is locked.
